title: Standing desks under $600 for a two-monitor home office
variant: Airy, verdict strip first, four picks in a two-by-two grid
prompt: Which standing desk under $600 should I buy for my home office? I'm 5'10", I switch between sitting and standing a few times a day, and I have a two-monitor setup.
note: Airy and light: a serif title, a brand-green verdict strip first so the pick and its price are on screen before anything else, and the four picks as a two-by-two card grid with only the top pick bordered. Most sections sit directly on the background with a kicker and no chrome, because a reader deciding this week skims for the verdict and the flaws and reads the rest only if the pick surprises them. A pick bar appears once the verdict scrolls away, as progressive enhancement. A photo sits on every pick card and beside the verdict, sized to one aspect ratio so the grid stays even; they are representative of the category because the research is illustrative.
